I understand that a non-biased source is most likely hard to come by given the nature of politics, but I was hoping some of you know of something out there. I would like to become more involved in what it is my country is doing. I just don't know how to go about starting that process.
What are some good, non-biased sources for someone looking to better understand American politics?

You aren't going to find many unbiased sources. Your best bet is to look for sources that don't hide their biases and get multiple perspectives. Here are some of my picks:

Reason - Libertarian magazine. Has some excellent critiques of both left and right wing politics.

NPR - Lots of good info, but has a solidly leftwing establishment viewpoint. They try to hide it and/or try to avoid it, but they have a consistent bias. Big NPR fans will claim it doesn't have bias, but an honest review shows it does.

Drudge Report - conservative new aggregator.

BBC News - British news service. Doesn't fit perfectly on our left-right scale, but is largely establishment left from our perspective.
I enjoy Democracy Now. Though I get a lot of my information from Voat and Reddit.
Thanks for the addition. I'm sure I've been there before, but would you mind mentioning what their typical bias is so that we can keep an eye out for it?
Probably leans left, but I don't think the bias is very strong. However, I could be wrong because of the lens I look through.

Real clear politics aggregates some of the best opinion pieces and a few of the longer "think pieces" published each day. Each one individually is of course very biased but RCP does a good job of pulling them from a variety of perspectives.

They also aggregate all the public polling available and from that derive their own composite "RCP average" of the polls. Useful to take a peak at that when reading various triumphalist opinion pieces about how "Hillary is on the Ropes" or "The Debate Was the End for Trump" when the polling shows Hillary still holding a commanding (if somewhat diminished) lead and Trump continuing to surge after the debate.
Start attending local City Council meetings where you could have an actual effect on political matters.
